tooltip.jaymospowers.hunter.slow_mending: Mends you a little each second, and costs you hunger for it
tooltip.jaymospowers.hunter.grey_sight: In the dark, you see in it, and the living things near you show as outlines
tooltip.jaymospowers.hunter.deep_breath: Under water, you do not run out of air, and are stronger
tooltip.jaymospowers.hunter.thorned_bloo: The dead who strike you are hurt for it; at the top grade they bleed
tooltip.jaymospowers.hunter.thin_venom: Poison runs out of you faster
tooltip.jaymospowers.hunter.cleanser: Takes every harm and the ordinary toxin off you, but not the load of a monster brew
tooltip.jaymospowers.hunter.marsh_fury: Ten minutes: you hit harder while at full health
tooltip.jaymospowers.hunter.grave_hunger: Ten minutes: each kill in a row heals you
tooltip.jaymospowers.hunter.pack_marrow: Ten minutes: you are fed while no one has touched you
tooltip.jaymospowers.hunter.fog_shroud: Ten minutes: harm is halved in the rain
tooltip.jaymospowers.hunter.imp_gallop: Ten minutes: your mount is faster
tooltip.jaymospowers.hunter.troll_blood: Ten minutes: you heal as a troll does
research.jaymospowers.formula_slow_mendi: A draught that closes wounds slowly, and eats at the stomach to do it.
research.jaymospowers.formula_grey_sight: A draught that lets the eye find its way in the dark and picks out the living things about you.
research.jaymospowers.formula_savagery.t: A draught of war and heat in the blood: a blow that crits hits harder.
A draught that puts an edge on the arm: swords hit harder.
research.jaymospowers.formula_deep_breat: A draught for the drowned work: air that does not run out, and strength, under water.
research.jaymospowers.formula_thorned_bl: A draught that turns the blood against the dead who strike it.
research.jaymospowers.formula_thin_venom: A draught that thins the poison in the blood: fewer ticks of it.
research.jaymospowers.formula_plenty.tex: A draught that feeds, and a lot, at once.
research.jaymospowers.formula_cleanser.t: A draught that clears the blood of harms and ordinary toxin. A monster brew's heavy load stays until the brew is spent.
research.jaymospowers.formula_marsh_fury: Brewed from the gall of a mire hag.
research.jaymospowers.formula_grave_hung: Brewed from the tongue of a grave hag.
research.jaymospowers.formula_pack_marro: Brewed from the marrow of a gnawer pack's leader.
research.jaymospowers.formula_fog_shroud: Brewed from the sac of a fog-wight.
research.jaymospowers.formula_imp_gallop: Brewed from the gizzard of a warrior imp.
research.jaymospowers.formula_troll_bloo: Brewed from the liver of a troll.
tooltip.jaymospowers.hunter.heavy: A heavy load that stays in the body as long as it works
tooltip.jaymospowers.formula: Use it to learn the brew for good
research.jaymospowers.poison_pastes.text: Poison paste dropped into a hot crucible with venom, rot and fire becomes toxic paste. Over heat in the Brewer's Alembic, toxic paste distils into pure toxin, one paste fewer.
tooltip.jaymospowers.testing_needle: Hold a poison in your other hand and prick a strong creature near death with it, to learn the poison's lean
message.jaymospowers.needle.no_reagent: Hold a poison in your other hand.
message.jaymospowers.needle.not_ready: It must be a strong creature, and near death.
message.jaymospowers.lean.learned: You have learned the lean of %s.
tooltip.jaymospowers.spent_phial: Refilled with strong spirit at the alchemy bench, by sleeping, or sitting at a fire
tooltip.jaymospowers.spent_casing: Refilled with strong spirit at the alchemy bench, by sleeping, or sitting at a fire
message.jaymospowers.bench.nothing: Nothing to refill. Bring strong spirit.
tooltip.jaymospowers.hunters_flask: Sneak with a bottle in the other hand to pour it in. Use to drink a dose, which works longer than the bottle would
jei.jaymospowers.alchemy_bench: Use it with strong spirit in your pack and your spent phials, spent casings and hunter's flasks are refilled, three to a bottle.
